visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use textContent for plain text
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The script uses innerHTML to show a number and plain words, which need no HTML. Use textContent. The page must show the same text.

solution.explanation: When the text has no markup, textContent is faster and safer, and it says what the code means: this is text, not HTML.

checks.label: The first paragraph reads Total items
